pages.title: Tangara Game Lodge | Luxury Safari in Limpopo
pages.description: Tangara Private Game Reserve offers outstanding accommodation and wildlife experiences in the malaria-free Waterberg region of Limpopo, South Africa.

Welcome to Tangara
A sanctuary in the shadow of the Waterberg mountains
Set under shady African trees and surrounded by the majestic Waterberg mountains, Tangara is comprised of a select number of self catering suites with privacy and comfort in mind.
Wake up to the sound of birds before going out to explore the bush and meet with the abundance of game and birdlife. Graceful giraffe frame the trees and nearby impala play around while tsessebe stare you down.
Located in the shadows of the Waterberg mountains, Tangara is a mere 1½ hours drive from Pretoria and situated in the malaria free area of Limpopo Province near Mookgophong (formerly Naboomspruit).

Immersive experiences
Every moment at Tangara inspires—from the first light of a bush hike to the golden hour of a sunset drive.
Luxury Accommodation
A select number of self catering suites designed for comfort, each blending seamlessly with the surrounding bushveld.
Game Viewing
Encounter giraffe, impala, tsessebe, and abundant birdlife through the reserve.
Conference Centre
Purpose-built event facilities in a serene bush setting, ideal for team and family gatherings.
Hunting
Professional hunting experiences guided by experienced hands, with respect for nature and sustainable practices.
Bird watching
We are situated approximately 10km from the Nylsvley Nature Reserve, regarded as one of the premier bird watching localities in the country.
Prime Location
Only 1½ hours from Pretoria in the malaria-free area of Limpopo, near Mookgophong.

Stay With Us
Two lodges. One reserve.
Choose Tangara or Badseloop — both offer private, comfortable suites in the malaria-free Waterberg.
Tangara
Stay at Tangara
Each suite at Tangara is designed for privacy, comfort, and a close connection to the bush. Self-catering stays with en-suite bathrooms and views of the Waterberg.
A natural fit for couples, families, and small groups who want a quiet lodge stay on the reserve.
Private self-catering suites

Enquire — Tangara
Badseloop Lodge
Stay at Badseloop
Badseloop Lodge sits on the same reserve, with its own character and accommodation. A classic bush lodge stay — comfortable rooms, easy access to game viewing, and the Waterberg as a backdrop.
Ideal if you already know Badseloop, or if you want a second option alongside Tangara for family or group bookings.

Location
In the heart of the Waterberg
Tangara is set in the malaria-free bushveld of Limpopo Province, just outside Mookgophong (formerly Naboomspruit). The Waterberg mountains provide a dramatic backdrop to every experience.
Only 1½ hours from Pretoria, the lodge is easily accessible yet feels worlds away from the city. It is the perfect destination for a weekend safari, a longer retreat, or a specialised hunting experience.
